user.title: Alexa MA Skill
user.description: The integration checks whether the Supervisor is available and then configures the add-on or an externally managed container.

addon.title: Configure the add-on
addon.description: The Alexa MA Skill add-on must be installed. Strong panel credentials will be generated. The Amazon login is always manual.

data_description.skill_hostname: Bare hostname only, for example skill.example.com. The tunnel must forward it to add-on port 5000.
data_description.ma_hostname: Bare hostname only, for example ma.example.com. Optional for display-only/APL devices; required for devices without a screen. The tunnel must forward it to the Music Assistant stream port, usually 8097.
data_description.locale: Locale used when creating and enabling the Alexa skill.
data_description.enable_apl: Enable Alexa Presentation Language on display-capable devices.
data_description.skip_url_validation: Do not validate the Music Assistant stream URL before sending it to Alexa.
data_description.ma_api_url: Base URL of the Music Assistant WebSocket API on port 8095. This is not the stream port 8097. The token is optional when the API does not require authentication.
data_description.ma_api_token: Music Assistant API token. Optional; use it when the API requires authentication. Requires MA_API_URL.
data_description.ignore_https: Skip certificate verification during the connectivity test. Use only for hairpin NAT or self-signed test endpoints.

addon_select.title: Select the add-on
addon_select.description: More than one add-on matches the Alexa MA Skill base slug. Select which one the integration should manage.

manual.title: Manual configuration
manual.description: Use the internal URL of an externally managed container. The Amazon login is always manual.

data_description.base_url: Internal URL of the add-on container, for example alexa-ma-skill:5000 or 192.0.2.10:5000.
data_description.skill_hostname: Bare hostname only, for example skill.example.com.
data_description.ma_hostname: Bare hostname only, for example ma.example.com. Optional for display-only/APL devices; required for devices without a screen.
data_description.locale: Locale used when creating and enabling the Alexa skill.
data_description.enable_apl: Enable Alexa Presentation Language on display-capable devices.
data_description.skip_url_validation: Do not validate the Music Assistant stream URL before sending it to Alexa.
data_description.ma_api_url: Base URL of the Music Assistant WebSocket API on port 8095. This is not the stream port 8097. The token is optional when the API does not require authentication.
data_description.ma_api_token: Music Assistant API token. Optional; use it when the API requires authentication. Requires MA_API_URL.
data_description.ignore_https: Skip certificate verification if the internal URL uses HTTPS with a self-signed certificate.

credentials.title: Generated credentials
credentials.description:
Save these credentials; they will not be shown again.

Username: `{username}`
Password: `{password}`

They were also written to the add-on options.

data_description.confirm: Submit to create the integration entry. The credentials will not be shown again.

reauth_confirm.title: Reauthenticate
reauth_confirm.description: In managed mode the credentials are re-read from the add-on options. In manual mode, enter the new credentials. The Amazon login is always manual.

data.confirm: Retry after fixing the add-on options

data_description.confirm: Submit this form again after correcting APP_USERNAME/APP_PASSWORD in the add-on options.
data_description.base_url: Internal URL of the add-on container.
data_description.ignore_https: Skip certificate verification if the internal URL uses HTTPS with a self-signed certificate.

error.invalid_hostname: Invalid hostname or URL. Use a bare hostname without a scheme, a path, or a port.
error.https_unreachable: Could not reach {host} over HTTPS. Check DNS, the tunnel, and the certificate. For hairpin NAT, enable 'Ignore HTTPS verification'. The panel credentials were already written to the add-on; fix the endpoint and run setup again.
error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the add-on. Check that it is running and that the internal URL is correct.
error.addon_not_installed: The Alexa MA Skill add-on is not installed. Add the repository flaviocorrea13/alexa-skill in the add-on store, install Alexa MA Skill, then try again.
error.invalid_addon_slug: Select one of the discovered Alexa MA Skill add-ons.
error.addon_selection_required: More than one Alexa MA Skill add-on was found. Select one in the integration options.
error.addon_options_invalid: The options stored in the add-on could not be validated. Check the add-on options.
error.addon_start_timeout: The add-on did not respond within 90 seconds. Check the add-on logs and try again.
error.ma_api_incomplete: MA_API_TOKEN requires MA_API_URL. MA_API_URL can be used without a token when Music Assistant does not require authentication.

abort.already_configured: Alexa MA Skill is already configured.
abort.reauth_failed: Reauthentication failed. Start the configuration again.

restart_confirm.title: Restart the add-on
restart_confirm.description: Options saved. Changed: {changes}. Restart the add-on now? The service may be unavailable briefly.

settings.title: Alexa MA Skill options
settings.description: In managed mode, changes are synchronized with the add-on and the add-on is restarted when needed. The Amazon login is always manual.

data.password: Password (leave empty to keep the current one)
data.ma_api_token: Music Assistant API token (leave empty to keep the current one)

data_description.skill_hostname: Bare hostname only, for example skill.example.com.
data_description.ma_hostname: Bare hostname only, for example ma.example.com. Optional for display-only/APL devices; required for devices without a screen.
data_description.password: Leave empty to keep the current password.
data_description.locale: Locale used when creating and enabling the Alexa skill.
data_description.enable_apl: Enable Alexa Presentation Language on display-capable devices.
data_description.skip_url_validation: Do not validate the Music Assistant stream URL before sending it to Alexa.
data_description.skill_id: Skill ID returned by the setup flow, used to restrict requests to this skill. Leave empty to use the detected value when available.
data_description.addon_slug: Supervisor slug of the add-on to manage. Shown when more than one match is found.

data_description.scan_interval: Cheap status polling interval, from 10 to 300 seconds. The detailed ASK check remains at about 5 minutes.
data_description.ignore_https: Skip certificate verification for HTTPS checks.
